items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: The interviewee lists members of Joel Lazard's band (Buddy Johnson, Frankie Doosen, etc.) but does not state that he himself was a member or played in the band.

ctx.x: That's Joel Lazard you're talking about? Joel Lazard, that's right.
Well, who was in Joel Lazard's band?

items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: So, Lizard, them, they could play, you know, but they wasn't like them fellas.

ctx.x: Oh, you got car property down in the country? Yeah. Who was the best cornet player when you were young?

When I was young, old man. Now, the best cornet player was Nauman and Fess's uncle. And then the old man used to lead that band, Verrett. George? George Verrett and Emmanuel coming after them. Them were all the best cornet players at the time. So, Lizard, them, they could play, you know, but they wasn't like them fellas. He was old French, but he didn't know the music. You understand? Old man is correct. Well, he was hard. He was an old man, but he was hard. George Murray.
